rootCause: SEO summaries were imported as a full JSON module through route/component code, causing the summary dataset to be reachable from broad client and SSR chunks.

The production SSR bundle also statically analyzed the development-only generated-book review-content module, expanding import.meta.glob over generated manifests and sections and exhausting the 4096 MB heap during SSR transform.
summaryLoadingStrategy: Client-safe summary module now exports only types, constants, and paragraph splitting.
Route loaders use a server-only summary lookup and pass only the current summary or compact description map to rendered components.
The server-only summary lookup reads the JSON data lazily from disk instead of importing it as bundled JS.
Netlify includes the summary JSON as a function data file.
Development-only generated-book review-content loading is opaque to production Vite analysis, preventing generated section globs from entering the SSR build graph.
